item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We stand for putting that growth to work: new industries, new careers and more opportunities for people.

2. We reject the idea that more capable machines mean less opportunity for people. If superintelligent AI arrives within 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. Our priority is making those opportunities broadly accessible.

3. We see a future of expanding opportunity, not disappearing work. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We want workers equipped to shape that future and share in its rewards.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We see this as a reason to prepare with purpose, not retreat in fear. New capabilities will open new industries, make previously impossible services practical and generate demand for work we have not yet imagined. We do not dismiss the disruption that changing jobs will bring. We insist that workers deserve the training, support and bargaining power to benefit from that change. Our task is to turn expanding technological capacity into broadly shared opportunity. We stand for a future with more jobs—and for making those jobs worth having.
